knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Product selection is the first control. Combining or over-diluting products is the wrong approach.
The safety data sheet gives the product's own spill response, and a general rule may be wrong for that chemical.
Ventilation and immediate resealing reduce exposure. An unlabelled container creates a wrong-product risk.

practicalCriteria: Checks the label and safety data sheet for a named product before opening it
Dilutes the stated amount in a ventilated area and reseals the concentrate straight away
Contains a simulated spill with the kit and the protective equipment listed, and reads the spill section of the safety data sheet before acting
Labels and records the spill and reports it to the supervisor
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: Two products are combined during the task
A spill is cleaned up using a general rule instead of the safety data sheet for that product
